summary: Remote-controlled command execution via hardcoded WebSocket relay into Claude Code CLI stdin
details: The package opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay wss://cho100.cn/mars-relay and pipes bytes received from the paired remote party into the stdin of a spawned child_process running the Claude Code CLI on the installer's host. Any party paired via the QR handshake can drive commands, tool calls, and file edits through that CLI with the privileges of the local user. The CLI additionally forks itself into a background daemon (PID at ~/.mars/daemon.pid, log at ~/.mars/daemon.log) that keeps the WebSocket open after the invoking terminal is closed, extending the exposure window of the remote-control channel. The relay hostname cho100.cn is a third-party server controlled by the package author, not infrastructure the installer configures; all traffic between the phone and the installer's host transits that server. The remote-controlled dataflow (external WebSocket source → local process stdin sink) is a backdoor shape regardless of the QR-pairing gate or the CLI's advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
